description: This file contains code for decoding MP7 video signatures, including data structures, lookup table generation, and signature parsing functions.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents an MP7 Frame Signature with a vector, elapsed time, and confidence level.

methods.name: calc_byte_to_bit3
methods.description: Builds a lookup table to convert an 8-bit value into five 3-bit values.

methods.name: pop_bits
methods.description: Extracts a specified number of bits from a bitarray starting at a given position and returns the value and new position.

methods.name: read_mp7_signature
methods.description: Decodes a binary MP7 video signature into a list of Frame objects.
